capabilities: Toggle a selected Markdown card between preview and link via its floating menu
Switch all Markdown cards on a canvas to links or back with one canvas control
Open notes from card links, with Ctrl/Cmd-click or middle-click for a new tab
Store per-card state in the canvas file's styleAttributes without changing note content
extras: Not yet in the community directory; must be built and installed by hand. The README warns it depends on internal Canvas objects and Advanced Canvas events, so updates to either can break it. It has no settings.
intentEvidence: Requires the Advanced Canvas plugin (advanced-canvas), version 7 or later.
problem: Obsidian canvases give no way to collapse Markdown file cards into compact links, so dense canvases stay cluttered with full previews.

relations.evidence: Canvas Card View adds its controls through Advanced Canvas and has nothing to attach to without it.

summary: Canvas plugin that toggles Markdown file cards between their editable preview and a compact link, per card or across the whole canvas.
